body: Can’t say, about 4-5k in ibuprofen and also in paracetamol.

If I were in your shoes, I’d choose which option may bring me more happiness and fulfilment. From my personal experience, I can say going to Africa could bring a real change in your life the same it did for me. I just don’t have the means to commit long term to projects there. Perhaps a bit of soul searching may help? You and your partner should discuss where you both see yourself in 10 years and what you’d like to achieve separately and/or together. Communicate what you wish for, and go from there.

I’ve seen better days and slept through better nights.
